G001.target_statement: Find a new place to live when moving to a new neighborhood or a new country, using housing web apps as the usual way to search.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原文明说搬到新社区或新国家时需要找新住所，并把上网使用这类 web app 作为常用方式；主体、情境与选定方式均在句内。
supported_parts: moving to a new neighborhood or country
searching on the Internet with housing web apps

G002.target_statement: Select the neighborhood or area in which to look for a house.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原句直接说通常先选定社区或地方再按关键词搜索；保留 usually 的习惯语气，未升级为强制。
supported_parts: choosing a neighborhood or place first

G003.target_statement: Check housing websites to see in which neighborhoods the listings that fit my budget and requirements are clustered, as one way to choose the area.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原文把查看房源网站、看预算与要求相符的房源是否集中在某些社区称为选社区的方式之一；保留 one of the ways，不声称这是唯一或充分方式。
supported_parts: options fitting budget and requirements cluster in some neighborhoods

G004.target_statement: Ask people who live in the target country for recommendations of places to look at.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原文把向当地居住者询问推荐列为另一种选社区的方式；引文含转写重复 other other，按原样引用。

G005.target_statement: Pick a neighborhood close to the place I regularly go to, such as a specific job or college.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句以 if…I will usually pick 明确该做法，工作与学校是举例而非固定业务；保留 usually 与举例性质。
supported_parts: picking a neighborhood close to job or college

G006.target_statement: Identify which housing websites are the most popular or most used in the target area by searching with location keywords.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原文说明按地区关键词搜索以找到该区域相关网站，并希望熟悉当地最流行或最常用的网站；结果与手段都在同一回答内。
supported_parts: knowing the most popular or used websites in the area

G007.target_statement: Draw an area on the map to define the search area, instead of searching only by neighborhood name.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原文明确喜欢地图画圈选区，并说明理由是按社区名搜索过窄会漏掉近处房源；目标保留了该方式与对比情境。
supported_parts: drawing a circle on the map to define the search area

G008.target_statement: Filter the listings by price range, size or bedroom count and home type, and by extra criteria such as move-in date, pets and utilities.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 两处回答分别给出面积/卧室数/预算与价格区间/床位浴位/房屋类型/搬家日期/宠物/水电等筛选条件，属同一筛选动作的多个限定，合并保留。

G009.target_statement: Narrow the remaining options further with lower-priority criteria such as amenities, extra features and how good the place looks.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原文把设施、额外功能、外观称为 non very important criteria 并用于进一步收窄；保留其较低优先级，不写成同等必备。
supported_parts: further filtering with amenities, extra features, looks

G010.target_statement: Contact the people offering the shortlisted places after the options have been narrowed down.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句明确在筛选到若干选项后开始沟通；目标只保留联系动作与前置条件，未把回复结果写进本目标。

G011.target_statement: Narrow the options further using how fast and how completely the providers reply.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原文说回复速度会影响选择，且沟通环节帮助收窄选项；保留 might 的不确定语气，不把它写成硬性淘汰规则。

G012.target_statement: Contact the provider through other channels such as their own website, phone or email when they do not respond in the app.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原句在未获回复的情境下明确说改用邮件或电话等其他方式，并提到通过名称或地图找联系方式；条件已写入 context。
supported_parts: email or phone as other methods

G013.target_statement: Carry out the communication with providers outside the housing apps, keeping those apps mainly as a way to discover places.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原句同时说明平台的用途（发现房源）与沟通发生在站外；两个分句是同一立场的两面，合为一个目标。

G014.target_statement: See when the listing information was last updated, so that I can be assured it is up to date.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 多处独立表述同一要求：想看最后更新时间（T019/T021/T059），并明确只想确信信息是最新的（T067/T069）；对象与目的一致。
supported_parts: be assured the information is up to date

G015.target_statement: See what happens after contacting a provider, including whether and when they will reply and what to expect if the contact fails.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原文要求网站展示下一步时间线、失败时的预期，并在电商类比中重复想知道何时回复、接着会发生什么；本目标合并这些同义表述。
supported_parts: what to expect if it fails

G016.target_statement: Communicate with the provider in a short, direct way instead of through a long form whose submission I cannot follow.
G016.label: inferred
G016.rationale: 由“不觉得能简短沟通”的抱怨反推期望，并有“若网站让沟通更容易会很好”“把沟通留在站内”作为正面依据；无直接祈使，故记 inferred 而非 direct。
supported_parts: short communication instead of a long form of unknown submission
assumptions: 抱怨所指向的期望状态是能够简短沟通
reasoning_steps: 识别抱怨对象为站内沟通方式
结合 T050/T071 的正面表述推断期望方向

G017.target_statement: See reviews from people who have lived there, so that the place feels more trusted and the information is in one place.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原文明确喜欢网站提供评论并说明理由（更可信、信息集中）；保留 could help 的弱化语气，未写成必须。

G018.target_statement: Have the website enforce a standard photo format for listings, so that listing photos can be trusted.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原文以 maybe 提出由网站规则统一照片格式并期望带来信任；建议强度弱，已在理由与 context 保留，不升级为强制要求。
supported_parts: website rules on standard photo format
assumptions: 网站有能力对房东施加照片格式规则

G019.target_statement: Contact a provider without having to fill in all the mandatory personal fields, the exact bed and bath counts and a custom message.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 原文逐项说明不想填必填个人信息、精确床位/浴位与自定义消息，并说这使其跳过站内申请；目标只概括这些明确不愿填的内容，未新增字段。
supported_parts: not exact bed and bath counts

G020.target_statement: Share my personal information only after both sides have confirmed availability and interest.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原句明确信息提供可以在双方确认可用性与兴趣之后，并说此前没有必要且不舒服；条件与顺序均保留。

G021.target_statement: Start searching and use the site's full functionality without registering or logging in.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: 原文明确“不应被强制注册/登录”，并把注册保留为可选的自助便利；目标保留了可选性与“直接使用全部功能”的期望。

G022.target_statement: Avoid long processes with buttons whose outcome I cannot predict, preferring sites that keep the options minimal and list what can be done.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原文以“不喜欢—会跳过该类网站—去找选项最少、事项清楚的网站”表达明确的避免与取舍方向；写成避免型目标而非禁止性规则。
supported_parts: prefer minimal options and listed actions

G023.target_statement: Find the listings I have favorited in the nav bar or at the first level of the menu after saving them.
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: 原文先说明收藏应能保存且现在找不到保存位置，再明确应放在导航栏或菜单第一层；位置要求与可找回性是同一目标。
supported_parts: in nav bar or first menu level

G024.target_statement: Compare three or four shortlisted options side by side on a single page.
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 两处（首次提出与结尾重申）都明确希望有比较功能，把 3-4 个选项集中到一页同时看主要特征；数量与目的均保留。
supported_parts: main features at the same time

G025.target_statement: Keep the filters optional, so that I am not forced to enter criteria I am not sure about.
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原文对筛选可选、不强制填写明确表示喜欢并给出理由；这是对现状的维持意图，故保留为维持型目标而非新增要求。
supported_parts: reason: not always sure what I want

G026.target_statement: Be able to include listings whose provider left a criterion unspecified when filtering, alongside the listings that confirmed it.
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: 原文先提出想同时看到已确认与未填写的房源，再给出复选框方案；目标保留“两者都能看到”的含义，方式作为具体建议不入目标正文。

G027.target_statement: Get an overview of the available options and their price ranges in the new area.
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: 原文说明筛选与网站汇集选项带来价格区间、可选房源、评论与位置的总览，并明确这是想要获得的信息；保留尤其针对跨国搬家的情境。

G028.target_statement: Carry out all housing communication with providers in one place on the website.
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: 原文两处都表达把所有房屋沟通放在同一平台/站内；“若流程清楚快速”是其明确条件，已写入 context，未当作已满足。
supported_parts: all communication in a single platform

G029.target_statement: Reach a home decision within a week, or at most a month, in the typical case.
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: 原文说找房不是长过程、有时希望一周内、最多一个月内决定；保留 sometimes 的典型情形语气，未写成硬性截止。
